name: Makri Island

encoding.terrain: int16 LE, real metres x 4, row 0 north

bathymetry.name: EMODnet Bathymetry Digital Terrain Model (mean depth)
bathymetry.attribution: EMODnet Bathymetry Consortium (2022/2024): EMODnet Digital Bathymetry (DTM)
bathymetry.method: EMODnet DTM where it reports water deeper than 1.5 m; cells within two grid cells of the OSM coastline, or where the 115 m DTM reports land, use a linear shelf approximation (1 m + 0.040 x distance, capped at 50 m)

coastline.name: OpenStreetMap natural=coastline
coastline.note: All coastline in the area is closed island rings.

approximations: Copernicus GLO-30 is a surface model: forest canopy and buildings are included in land heights (typically +5 to +25 m in dense forest).
Land cells the DEM puts at or below sea level but OSM marks as land are raised to 0.6-1.0 m (0.01 km2).

Sea depth: EMODnet DTM where it reports water deeper than 1.5 m; cells within two grid cells of the OSM coastline, or where the 115 m DTM reports land, use a linear shelf approximation (1 m + 0.040 x distance, capped at 50 m)
The DEM was resampled bilinearly from 30 m to a 9.8 m grid.
